filename: Memory-based parameterization with differentiable solver_ Application to Lorenz ’96.pdf
title: Memory-based parameterization with differentiable solver: Application to Lorenz ’96
venue: Chaos: An Interdisciplinary Journal of Nonlinear Science
parameterization_target: Subgrid coupling tendency / closure term of the fast variables onto the slow variables
code_availability: All codes and data presented in this section are made publicly available at https://github.com/bhouri0412/Hist_Bayesian_Closure.
testbed_rationale: Uses a low-dimensional idealized dynamical system (Lorenz '96) rather than realistic Earth system model or atmospheric/oceanic dataset.
pain_points: Standard instantaneous parameterizations fail over long time horizons due to stochasticity and unobserved fast variables.
Delay Differential Equations with standard Runge-Kutta schemes risk requiring data interpolation across time-lags; avoided here by doubling integration time step.
Temporal coarse-graining and discretization introduce significant numerical errors in online integration.
extraction_notes: The paper uses the Lorenz '96 model as an idealized testbed for memory-based parameterization with a differentiable solver.
